rawContent: I remember the ACA passed and millions got health care. I remember millions said #MeToo and launching TIME'S Up LDF. I remember passing the Ledbetter Act. I remember marching saying #BLM with my kids. I remember celebrating the #KBJ confirmation. I remember the 2020 election.

They tried to declare #MeToo dead before it even started.

The answer lies in survivors joining together. We are always bigger than a legal system that fails us. Even with the silencing and retaliation.
